The '''royal family''' of [[Hargeeva]] ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[High King]] [[Makintay]] also served as [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Hargeeva. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Stevan Makintay]], his son, was disinherited from the family for insisting on marrying a lowborn commoner, [[Ketrian Altronel]].
